method: Manual endpoint-level decomposition of all 50 Verified question texts, checked against pinned question hashes. Summaries are paraphrases. No answer, distractor, result, reference notebook or biological fixture is used.
counting: Count each question once per competency. Focal means the requested endpoint; supporting means an explicitly needed component. Shared capsules are not independent workflows. Upstream operations are not assumed from a workflow-family label.
reward_policy: Only executable rewards are eligible for generation. Numeric-contract is a proposed artifact check, not implemented validation. Needs-definition requires a frozen scientific contract. Defer-interpretation excludes the open-ended endpoint; its numeric components may inform separate tasks.

competencies.name: Summarize and compare grouped measurements
competencies.outcome: Means, medians, extrema, ratios or differences with explicit grouping and order of aggregation.

competencies.name: Define eligible observations and denominators
competencies.outcome: An inclusion mask and denominator that preserve the intended patient, gene, variant, site or measurement unit.

competencies.name: Reconcile biological feature and sample identities
competencies.outcome: An auditable join across assays, annotations or replicates with duplicate and missing-identity policies.

competencies.name: Measure signal and composition in sequence alignments
competencies.outcome: Per-alignment parsimony-informative counts/fractions or relative composition variability under declared site rules.

competencies.name: Measure branch-length properties of phylogenetic trees
competencies.outcome: Treeness, evolutionary rate, long-branch score, patristic distance or tree length using a pinned metric definition.

competencies.name: Compare independent groups with a rank-based test
competencies.outcome: Mann–Whitney U statistic and p-value with group order, sidedness and tie handling declared.

competencies.name: Estimate design-aware differential gene expression
competencies.outcome: Count-model contrasts with sample design, normalization, dispersion, effect estimates and uncertainty.

competencies.name: Shrink differential-expression effect estimates
competencies.outcome: Shrunken log-fold changes with estimator and coefficient specified; significance tests kept distinct.

competencies.name: Adjust and compare multiple-testing procedures
competencies.outcome: A declared test family, adjusted p-values and rejection counts under the named procedure.

competencies.name: Test pathway overrepresentation
competencies.outcome: Gene universe, selected genes, pathway membership, contingency counts and enrichment statistics.

competencies.name: Compare direction-aware gene or pathway sets
competencies.outcome: Intersections, differences, membership counts or ranked-set subsets with explicit direction and significance rules.

competencies.name: Estimate rank associations between biological measurements
competencies.outcome: Spearman coefficients or tests on matched observations, preserving ties and missingness policy.

competencies.name: Estimate linear associations between biological measurements
competencies.outcome: Pearson correlations on the declared feature population and measurement scale.

competencies.name: Filter and summarize annotated cohort variants
competencies.outcome: Per-patient/gene burdens or annotation proportions with VAF, consequence and reference-call filters.

competencies.name: Classify nucleotide substitutions and calculate Ts/Tv
competencies.outcome: Transition and transversion counts, allele policy and their ratio.

competencies.name: Map reads to a reference with declared alignment settings
competencies.outcome: Reference-aligned reads with the requested mapper, reference and read-group metadata.

competencies.name: Calculate genome-wide read coverage with zero-depth bases
competencies.outcome: Depth sum and full reference-length denominator, with alignment/base inclusion rules.

competencies.name: Transform expression data and interpret PCA variance
competencies.outcome: An oriented and transformed matrix, fitted components and explained-variance fractions.

competencies.name: Fit nonlinear biological response curves
competencies.outcome: Fitted polynomial or spline response functions under explicit design and basis choices.

competencies.name: Compare statistical models using a declared criterion
competencies.outcome: Likelihood, parameter count, AIC or another prespecified selection criterion.

competencies.name: Find a bounded optimum of a fitted response
competencies.outcome: An optimum over the allowed biological domain, including boundary checks.

competencies.name: Fit and interpret a binary logistic response model
competencies.outcome: Unpenalized or explicitly specified fits, outcome encoding, coefficient units and likelihood.

competencies.name: Identify complete shared single-copy orthologues
competencies.outcome: Per-proteome BUSCO completeness and copy status, then an intersection across proteomes.

competencies.name: Compare measured colony morphology across conditions
competencies.outcome: Condition-level area/circularity summaries and contrasts; segmentation is not assumed.

competencies.name: Calculate protein abundance changes on the correct scale
competencies.outcome: Tumor/control abundance summaries, fold changes and log2 changes with normalization and aggregation stated.

competencies.name: Filter methylation observations while preserving row/site identity
competencies.outcome: Strict threshold masks, deduplicated site sets where requested, and retained/removed row counts.

competencies.name: Compute reference-length-normalized CpG densities
competencies.outcome: Unique-site counts divided by matched chromosome lengths, then chromosome-level comparisons.

competencies.name: Derive gene lengths from a declared annotation
competencies.outcome: Protein-coding gene identities and lengths under a frozen span/exon and transcript-selection rule.

competencies.name: Aggregate expression across the declared samples
competencies.outcome: Per-gene sample means on a stated scale and count-based eligibility filters.

competencies.name: Assess how cohort or replicate exclusions change an analysis
competencies.outcome: Comparable reruns with changed inclusion sets and endpoint differences.

competencies.name: Interpret directional pathway evidence in biological context
competencies.outcome: An evidence-backed biological claim; an unrestricted narrative is outside the current reward scope.

tasks.question_summary: Agreement between replicate CRISPR-screen p-values.
tasks.verification: Check the feature-aligned replicate p-value table and Spearman coefficient.
tasks.decisions: Use chronic round 1 and preserve ties. Running MAGeCK is not implied if its results are already inputs.

tasks.question_summary: Difference in median treeness between fungi and animals.
tasks.verification: Check each tree’s treeness and both group medians before their difference.
tasks.decisions: Output a decimal proportion, preserving fungi-minus-animals ordering.

tasks.question_summary: Fraction of fungal gene trees above a treeness threshold.
tasks.verification: Check per-tree treeness and numerator/denominator for the percentage.
tasks.decisions: Use strict >0.06 and an explicit eligible-gene denominator.

tasks.question_summary: Median fraction of informative alignment sites across fungal genes.
tasks.verification: Check per-gene site counts and eligible-site denominators, then the median percentage.
tasks.decisions: Freeze treatment of gaps and ambiguous residues; take the median of per-gene percentages.

tasks.question_summary: Rank-test statistic comparing informative-site percentages across groups.
tasks.verification: Check each alignment’s fraction and the U statistic.
tasks.decisions: Test per-gene percentages, not raw site counts; freeze group order and eligible-site rules.

tasks.question_summary: Largest informative-site count among animal gene alignments.
tasks.verification: Check all per-gene informative-site counts and the maximum.
tasks.decisions: Use counts, not fractions; freeze ambiguity and gap handling.

tasks.question_summary: Rank-test statistic comparing raw informative-site counts across groups.
tasks.verification: Check per-gene raw site counts and the U statistic.
tasks.decisions: Use counts, not percentages; freeze group order and ties.

tasks.question_summary: Synonymous fraction among low-VAF coding variants in carriers.
tasks.verification: Check the carrier/coding/VAF inclusion mask and synonymous numerator and denominator.
tasks.decisions: VAF is strictly <0.3; freeze variant unit and coding-consequence categories.

tasks.question_summary: Gene with the strongest negative expression–essentiality association.
tasks.verification: Check the complete gene-wise coefficient table and its minimum.
tasks.decisions: Use matched cell lines and declare ties, constant vectors and missing-value handling.

tasks.question_summary: Count of genes with strong positive expression–essentiality association.
tasks.verification: Check gene-wise matched observations and correlations before counting coefficients ≥0.6.
tasks.decisions: Preserve cell-line alignment and missingness; a coefficient threshold does not imply a significance test.

tasks.question_summary: Fraction of genes with significant expression–essentiality rank association.
tasks.verification: Check all correlation tests, the BH-adjusted vector and the significant fraction.
tasks.decisions: Retain both correlation directions; freeze significance cutoff, test family and treatment of constant/missing vectors.

tasks.question_summary: Median patient-level somatic-variant burden among carriers.
tasks.verification: Check cohort membership, variant mask, patient counts and their median.
tasks.decisions: Use VAF<0.3 and specified consequence/reference exclusions; retain eligible zero-variant patients.

tasks.question_summary: Mean circularity of the genotype with the greatest mean colony area.
tasks.verification: Check genotype-level mean area and circularity, then select by mean area.
tasks.decisions: Select the genotype first; do not return the maximum individual colony’s circularity. Freeze ties.

tasks.question_summary: Percent reduction in mean colony area for a mutant relative to wild type.
tasks.verification: Check group means and 100×(wildtype−mutant)/wildtype.
tasks.decisions: The wild-type mean is the denominator; define replicate weighting and rounding.

tasks.question_summary: Benign classification fraction among eligible annotated carrier variants.
tasks.verification: Check exclusions, ClinVar annotation eligibility and benign/likely-benign counts.
tasks.decisions: Restrict to VAF<0.3; exclude intronic, intergenic, UTR and reference calls. Denominator requires a ClinVar classification.

tasks.question_summary: Immune cell type with the weakest gene-length/expression correlation.
tasks.verification: Check gene lengths and mean expression for each cell type, all four correlations and the minimum absolute value.
tasks.decisions: Freeze span versus exon length, expression scale and eligibility; do not import Verified q4’s ≥10 filter into q1.

tasks.question_summary: Gene-length/expression correlation in expressed CD14 protein-coding genes.
tasks.verification: Check annotation joins, protein-coding and total-count≥10 filters, sample means and Pearson correlation.
tasks.decisions: Freeze gene-length definition and expression scale; the existing adaptation explicitly records its donor-CPM context.

tasks.question_summary: Whether up- or downregulated genes primarily explain metabolic pathway effects.
tasks.verification: Numerical DE and direction-separated GO tables are verifiable components; the broad interpretation is deferred.
tasks.decisions: Primarily drives metabolic effects lacks a quantitative rule. Do not replace it with a label or claim full coverage without a new explicit contract.

tasks.question_summary: Selected-gene overlap with a KEGG pathway under iron depletion.
tasks.verification: Check the upregulated DEG set and its intersection with the frozen pathway membership.
tasks.decisions: Use |log2FC|>1.5 and padj<0.05, retaining the positive direction and declared condition.

tasks.question_summary: Pathways enriched under iron depletion but not in the comparison condition.
tasks.verification: Check both DEG lists and pathway tests, then the significant-set difference.
tasks.decisions: Use |log2FC|>1.5, gene padj<0.05 and pathway padj<0.05. Lack of significance is not evidence of no effect.

tasks.question_summary: Variance explained by PC1 after a specified expression transformation.
tasks.verification: Check matrix orientation, log10(x+1), PCA configuration and PC1 explained variance.
tasks.decisions: Fit 100 components; declare centering/scaling and numerical tolerance; report percent in [0,100].

tasks.question_summary: Median long-branch score for a specified fungal gene.
tasks.verification: Check the complete taxon-level long-branch scores and their median.
tasks.decisions: Use the pinned metric; branch lengths and within-tree aggregation matter.

tasks.question_summary: Ratio of significant miRNA counts under two multiple-testing corrections.
tasks.verification: Check the same raw p-value family, both adjusted vectors and Bonferroni:BY rejection counts.
tasks.decisions: Threshold is ≤0.05; preserve the ordered pair of counts and define zero-count handling.

tasks.question_summary: Sex-associated gene effect with batch adjustment and shrinkage.
tasks.verification: Check the declared count inputs, sex/batch design and requested shrunken gene effect.
tasks.decisions: The source combines batch-corrected counts and a batch covariate. Resolve count validity and double adjustment before authoring.

tasks.question_summary: Pathways enriched in the same direction across three mutant contrasts.
tasks.verification: Check per-mutant positive/negative gene sets, separate ORA results and direction-matched intersections.
tasks.decisions: Use |LFC|>1.5 for genes. Freeze the otherwise underspecified significance rules and background; do not assign a gene LFC to a pathway.

tasks.question_summary: Median patristic distance for a specified fungal gene.
tasks.verification: Check the pairwise distance table and median under a declared pair policy.
tasks.decisions: Freeze unordered versus ordered pairs, diagonal exclusion and missing branch lengths.

tasks.question_summary: Ratio of group medians of gene-level mean patristic distances.
tasks.verification: Check each gene’s mean pairwise distance, group medians and fungi/animals ratio.
tasks.decisions: Preserve within-gene mean followed by across-gene median; define pair policy.

tasks.question_summary: Evolutionary rate of a specified animal orthologue.
tasks.verification: Recompute the requested PhyKIT evolutionary-rate metric on the identified gene tree.
tasks.decisions: Pin the PhyKIT function/version and resolve the source’s misspelled function name.

tasks.question_summary: Rank-test statistic comparing animal and fungal evolutionary rates.
tasks.verification: Check per-gene evolutionary rates and the Mann–Whitney U statistic.
tasks.decisions: Freeze group order, missing trees and tie policy.

tasks.question_summary: Tumor-to-normal abundance fold change for a protein.
tasks.verification: Check sample-level abundance, group summaries and their ratio.
tasks.decisions: Normalization, missing values and ratio-of-means versus paired ratios require an explicit contract.

tasks.question_summary: Log2 tumor-to-normal abundance fold change for a protein.
tasks.verification: Check group-level abundance, ratio and log2 transform before two-decimal rounding.
tasks.decisions: Freeze abundance scale and aggregation; mean log difference and log ratio of means can differ.

tasks.question_summary: Fold change in median tree length between organism groups.
tasks.verification: Check per-tree lengths, group medians and fungi/animals ratio.
tasks.decisions: Freeze branch inclusion and missing-length behavior; retain the ratio direction.

tasks.question_summary: Mixture whose measured colony phenotype is closest to the reference strain.
tasks.verification: Check mean area/circularity by mixture and a declared distance to the reference.
tasks.decisions: Closest is underspecified across two differently scaled measurements. Freeze scaling, distance and tie rule.

tasks.question_summary: Reactome pathway enrichment odds ratio after a multi-group treatment contrast.
tasks.verification: Check the complete contrast, DEG inclusion mask and enrichment contingency table before the odds ratio.
tasks.decisions: Use all four specified groups for dispersion; counts >10 in at least one of all 30 samples; padj ≤0.05, |LFC| ≥0.5 and baseMean ≥10. Freeze Reactome_2022 background.

tasks.question_summary: DEG/pathway membership overlap fraction after a treatment contrast.
tasks.verification: Check DEG membership and the numerator/denominator for the named Reactome pathway.
tasks.decisions: Use padj<0.05 and |log2FC|≥0.5. Freeze pathway release/background; do not copy q2-specific filters without evidence.

tasks.question_summary: Rank-test p-value comparing alignment composition variability.
tasks.verification: Check per-alignment PhyKIT RCV values and the Mann–Whitney p-value.
tasks.decisions: Pin RCV definition, test sidedness, exact/asymptotic method and tie correction.

tasks.question_summary: Differential-expression effect for a specified gene and mutant contrast.
tasks.verification: Check the contrast and requested gene’s log2 fold change before rounding.
tasks.decisions: Freeze design and count-model settings; neither shrinkage nor enrichment is explicitly requested.

tasks.question_summary: Gene with the most non-reference variants in the oldest male carrier.
tasks.verification: Check patient selection and gene-level non-reference variant counts, then the argmax.
tasks.decisions: Freeze age ties, repeated variants and gene-mapping rules; do not import a somatic VAF filter from other questions.

tasks.question_summary: Number of significant genes in a sex-adjusted disease contrast with effect shrinkage.
tasks.verification: Check the sex-adjusted model, shrinkage artifacts and padj<0.05 rejection count.
tasks.decisions: Use apeglm; significance comes from the declared test, not the magnitude of a shrunken effect.

tasks.question_summary: AIC of a treatment-response logistic model using only BMI.
tasks.verification: Check the design matrix, likelihood, parameter count and AIC.
tasks.decisions: Include an intercept; declare event encoding, complete-case population and unpenalized fitting.

tasks.question_summary: Age coefficient in a single-predictor treatment-response logistic model.
tasks.verification: Check event encoding, intercept-plus-age fit and the raw-age log-odds slope.
tasks.decisions: Report coefficient per year, not odds ratio; do not include BMI or standardize age.

tasks.question_summary: Mean chromosome density of extreme-methylation, age-related CpG sites.
tasks.verification: Check the row filter, unique loci, chromosome lengths and arithmetic mean of eligible densities.
tasks.decisions: Use >90% or <10%; include only chromosomes with filtered sites; do not use pooled genome density.

tasks.question_summary: Chromosome with the greatest density of age-related CpG sites.
tasks.verification: Check all chromosome counts and densities before selecting the maximum.
tasks.decisions: Use age-related sites without importing q2’s extreme-methylation filter; freeze chromosome eligibility and ties.

tasks.question_summary: Number of methylation measurement rows removed by an extreme-value filter.
tasks.verification: Check the row-level strict-threshold mask and removed-row count.
tasks.decisions: Count observations, not unique CpG sites. Values exactly 10% and 90% are removed.

tasks.question_summary: Change in differential-gene count after excluding third replicates.
tasks.verification: Check both complete DE results, counts and the derived increase/decrease/unchanged label.
tasks.decisions: Use raw p<0.05, |log2FC|>1 and baseMean>10; freeze shrinker and rerun policies. The direction label is deterministic.

tasks.question_summary: Fraction of top enriched pathways with an oxidative-stress name match.
tasks.verification: Check selected genes, enrichment ranking, top-20 membership and the name-match fraction.
tasks.decisions: Use raw p<0.05, |LFC|>1 and baseMean>10; freeze WikiPathways_2019_Mouse, rank ties and rounding.

tasks.question_summary: Maximum colony area predicted by the selected nonlinear response model.
tasks.verification: Check all fitted candidate models, the selected model and its bounded optimum.
tasks.decisions: The question does not specify what best-fitting means. Freeze selection criterion, spline basis and observed frequency domain.

tasks.question_summary: Complete single-copy orthologues shared by four proteomes.
tasks.verification: Check complete single-copy status in each proteome and the four-way intersection.
tasks.decisions: Pin BUSCO and eukaryota_odb10; exclude duplicated, fragmented and missing calls.

tasks.question_summary: Whole-reference average depth after a specified bacterial read alignment.
tasks.verification: Check the declared BWA-MEM alignment and depth sum divided by full reference length.
tasks.decisions: Include zero-depth bases; preserve the required read group and freeze SAMtools flag/base-quality rules.

tasks.question_summary: Transition/transversion ratio in a bacterial sample.
tasks.verification: Check eligible substitution counts, Ts/Tv and two-decimal rounding.
tasks.decisions: Freeze variant filters, multiallelic decomposition and treatment of indels; upstream calling is input-dependent.
